verdict.rationale: Cloudflare's Universal SSL docs say it issues and renews free, publicly trusted certificates for every domain added to and activated on Cloudflare, which covers the free and auto-renewing parts of the story for domains fronting Workers. Nothing in the pack mentions wildcard certificates, and the evidence comes from Cloudflare's general SSL docs, not Workers-specific docs. missing for 10: evidence of wildcard certificate coverage, Workers-specific documentation of certificate issuance for custom domains, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can get free, automatically renewing TLS certificates for every domain including wildcards

citations.quote: Cloudflare issues — and renews — free, unshared, publicly trusted SSL certificates to all domains added to and activated on Cloudflare.
